_readme: Single source of truth for the Chog Swarm pinball table. Both the physics world and the renderer MUST be built from this file. Table units: playfield plus plunger lane is 1.0 wide and 2.0 tall. Origin is top-left, x grows right, y grows down. Angles are in degrees measured from +x toward +y (down). Do not invent dimensions. If something does not fit, tell me instead of resizing it.
physicsScaleNote: Multiply table units by 20 to get physics meters so Box2D/Planck sees a ball radius of about 0.52 m.
gravityNote: Table units per second squared, pointing down. About a 6.5 degree incline. Ball should take roughly 1.2 to 1.8 s to roll from the top to the flippers.

topArch.note: Semicircle over the whole width including the plunger lane. Ball leaves the lane and rides the arch leftward.

oneWayGate.note: Ball may travel up through the gap from the lane, then cannot re-enter the lane.

plunger.note: Full charge must carry the ball up the lane and around the arch to the playfield.

flippers.note: Gap between the resting tips is about 0.07, which is 1.4 ball diameters. The ball can drain through it.

ghostNote: Ghost Chogs. Hits register as damage, the ball bounces off. Ghosts may drift up to 0.04 around their anchor using their trait-compiled policy. They must never overlap a wall or bumper.

cryptPortal.note: Captures the ball, plays the portal effect, ejects it back down toward the bumpers.

feel.stuckAction: Gently eject the ball upward from the nearest free point and flash a message.

validation: No collider may overlap another collider (except sensors).
A ball released at the plunger at full charge must reach the playfield.
A ball dropped from the top-center must reach the flippers in 1.2 to 1.8 seconds.
A well-timed flipper hit must be able to send the ball to the top arch.
Every ghost, bumper and lane must be reachable by some flipper shot.
